beats.narration_slice: Within hours, roads empty and power grids begin failing.
beats.visual: Charcoal-and-graphite high-angle view of a deserted urban avenue with stalled vehicles below and dark utility poles receding toward a hazy skyline, while one distant transformer gives off a faint cold-amber dying glow.
beats.purpose: show the immediate emptying of roads and the first visible signs of electrical-grid failure
beats.visual_fingerprint: high-angle deserted city avenue + stalled vehicles + failing transformer + long vanishing-point composition in overcast daylight
beats.continuity: establish the abandoned post-human world immediately after the Flow sequence

beats.narration_slice: Without operators, pumps stop and tunnels start flooding.
beats.visual: Low interior charcoal view inside a silent underground pumping chamber, with inactive machinery looming on one side as dark water spills through a tunnel mouth and spreads across the foreground floor.
beats.purpose: show how unattended pumping infrastructure fails and allows underground spaces to flood
beats.visual_fingerprint: low-angle underground pump chamber + stopped machinery + advancing floodwater + enclosed tunnel setting
beats.continuity: move from surface infrastructure failure down into a dependent underground system

beats.narration_slice: Pets trapped indoors face danger first.
beats.visual: Intimate charcoal interior of a dim abandoned apartment, centered on a worried house cat beside an empty tipped water bowl near a closed doorway, with soft window haze isolating the animal.
beats.purpose: show why dependent indoor pets become vulnerable very quickly
beats.visual_fingerprint: close apartment interior + isolated house cat + empty tipped bowl + closed-door composition with soft window light
beats.continuity: shift from failing civic systems to the earliest consequences for animals dependent on humans

beats.narration_slice: Livestock escape fences or die without care.
beats.visual: Wide charcoal rural scene of cattle pushing through a broken pasture fence into an overgrown roadside, with an abandoned barn receding behind them beneath a heavy gray sky.
beats.purpose: show livestock escaping human-controlled enclosures once routine care disappears
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide rural pasture + cattle crossing broken fence + abandoned barn + lateral movement toward overgrown roadside
beats.continuity: expand from confined domestic pets to larger managed animals breaking out into the landscape

beats.visual: Dramatic charcoal street-level view of flames consuming the upper floor of an empty building, smoke smearing into the soot-dark sky while no firefighters or people appear anywhere in the street.
beats.purpose: show how ordinary fires become destructive when nobody remains to suppress them
beats.visual_fingerprint: street-level burning building + empty foreground street + heavy diagonal smoke plume + sparse amber flame against soot-black charcoal
beats.continuity: escalate from passive neglect to an acute hazard that spreads without intervention

beats.narration_slice: Weeds crack pavement; vines climb buildings.
beats.visual: Ground-level charcoal composition focused on thick weeds forcing apart fractured asphalt in the foreground while a vine-covered building facade rises vertically behind them.
beats.purpose: show plant growth physically reclaiming streets and architecture
beats.visual_fingerprint: ground-level cracked pavement + weeds erupting through asphalt + towering vine-covered facade + strong foreground-to-background vertical contrast
beats.continuity: move from sudden destructive fire to slower biological takeover of damaged urban surfaces

beats.narration_slice: Rust, leaks, and frost weaken roofs.
beats.visual: Upward-looking charcoal view beneath a decaying industrial roof, where rusted beams frame a jagged leak, water stains spread across concrete, and frost has split the roof edge around a sagging section.
beats.purpose: show weather and corrosion progressively weakening unattended structures
beats.visual_fingerprint: upward interior roof angle + rusted beams + leaking ceiling + frost-split sagging edge + tight structural composition
beats.continuity: continue the decay sequence by moving from exterior plant damage to structural deterioration from weather

beats.narration_slice: Wild animals spread through quieter towns.
beats.visual: Long-lens charcoal view down a silent suburban street where a small group of deer walks between abandoned cars, framed by dark hedges and distant houses softened by graphite haze.
beats.purpose: show wildlife occupying human spaces once noise, traffic, and disturbance disappear
beats.visual_fingerprint: compressed suburban street + deer among abandoned cars + eye-level distant observation + quiet graphite-haze depth
beats.continuity: show living ecosystems taking advantage of the increasingly damaged and quiet built environment

beats.narration_slice: Satellites eventually fail or fall from orbit.
beats.visual: Charcoal orbital scene above the curved dark Earth, with one powerless satellite tumbling at a steep angle while a few small debris fragments trail away into black graphite space.
beats.purpose: show that even distant human technology eventually stops functioning and decays
beats.visual_fingerprint: orbital wide shot + tumbling dead satellite + curved Earth horizon + sparse debris against near-black graphite field
beats.continuity: jump outward from reclaimed towns to the farthest unattended systems humans left behind

beats.narration_slice: Stone, glass, plastic, and monuments can outlast generations.
beats.visual: Low wide charcoal view of a weathered stone monument standing amid collapsed modern structures, with broken glass catching pale light and tangled plastic remnants lodged among rubble and dead moss.
beats.purpose: show which durable human-made materials and structures can remain long after everyday systems collapse
beats.visual_fingerprint: low wide ruin field + enduring stone monument + scattered glass and plastic remnants + collapsed modern architecture surrounding central survivor
beats.continuity: return from orbit to Earth and contrast fast system failures with materials that persist for generations

beats.narration_slice: Nature wouldn't erase us quickly; it would build over us.
beats.visual: Reflective charcoal vista of a partially collapsed city block almost engulfed by mature trees, vines, moss, and layered vegetation, with recognizable stone and concrete ruins still visible beneath the growth.
beats.purpose: summarize the long-term outcome as ecological succession building over persistent human remains rather than instantly erasing them
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide elevated ruin vista + mature forest overtaking city block + architecture visibly layered beneath vegetation + diffuse late-day haze
beats.continuity: resolve the sequence by combining persistent ruins with advanced ecological reclamation while staying entirely inside the abandoned world
